name: Ramona
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Ramona, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Ramona, CA: the Main Street Tree Lighting with Santa, the Candlelight Christmas Dinner, free Santa photos and stockings.
lede: Ramona does Christmas on Main Street. On the first Saturday in December the chamber closes the road through Old Town for a tree lighting where Santa himself climbs up to light the tree in front of the town museum.
celebrates: The Ramona Chamber of Commerce organizes the Annual Christmas Tree Lighting on the first Saturday in December. Main Street closes between 6th and 8th Streets for vendors, carolers, dancers, kids' crafts, a classic car display and photos with Santa, and local school and church choirs perform. The town tree stands in front of the Ramona Heritage Museum at 645 Main Street, where the chamber also hosts a Candlelight Christmas Dinner inside the museum gates. Before the big night, families hunt for hidden elves in Main Street shops for the Find the Elf contest, and local businesses add their own Santa visits.
lastyear: Ramona's 33rd annual Christmas Tree Lighting took place on Saturday, December 6, 2025. Hundreds of people came as 6th to 8th Streets closed from 4 to 9:30 pm. A draft horse and donkeys dressed for the holidays stood at one end of the street and a classic car display at the other. Town Hall showed free Christmas movies with popcorn while Santa posed for photos, the Immaculate Heart of Mary Church staged a live nativity with children, and just before 7 pm Santa climbed a ladder beside the tree for the countdown.
facts: Ramona took its name in 1886 from Helen Hunt Jackson's popular novel Ramona, when a land company laid out a townsite in the Santa Maria Valley. Because another Ramona existed in Los Angeles County, the town went back to its first name, Nuevo, the next year, and only took Ramona for good in 1894. The Verlaque House, the 1886 home behind the town Christmas tree, is listed on the National Register of Historic Places, as is Ramona Town Hall, built in 1894 and once home to the town's first high school.
trains: Ramona has no train station of its own. The closest rail line is North County Transit District's SPRINTER, a 22 mile hybrid rail line with 15 stations that runs along the Highway 78 corridor from Oceanside to its eastern end at the Escondido Transit Center, where it meets MTS express buses. For a holiday train ride, the volunteer Poway-Midland Railroad runs a 1907 Baldwin steam locomotive and a 1906 San Francisco cable car around Old Poway Park, with night rides during Poway's Christmas in the Park.

kidfact: Ramona's Santa does not just flip a switch. Last year he climbed up a tall ladder next to the tree while the whole street went dark, then everyone counted down together until the lights came on.
faq: When is the Ramona Christmas Tree Lighting?

The Ramona Chamber of Commerce holds its Annual Christmas Tree Lighting on the first Saturday in December, from 5 to 9 pm, with Santa lighting the tree at 7 pm. Main Street closes between 6th and 8th Streets for vendors, music, dancers, kids' crafts and a classic car display, and the tree stands in front of the Ramona Heritage Museum at 645 Main Street.
Where is the Ramona Christmas tree?

The town tree is set up on the front grounds of the Ramona Heritage Museum, also called the Guy B. Woodward Museum, at 645 Main Street. The museum's 1886 Verlaque House stands behind it, and on tree lighting night the chamber's Candlelight Christmas Dinner takes place inside the museum gates with the tree in full view.
What is the Find the Elf contest in Ramona?

In the days before the tree lighting, elves hide inside participating shops in Old Town Ramona between 6th and 8th Streets plus a few bonus locations. Families pick up a passport, find each elf, get the passport stamped or signed at the register, and turn it in by 6:30 pm on tree lighting night for a prize drawing.
How did Ramona get its name?

In 1886 a land company headed by Milton Santee laid out a townsite in the Santa Maria Valley and named it Ramona after Helen Hunt Jackson's novel. Another town called Ramona already existed in Los Angeles County, so the name went back to Nuevo the next year. Nuevo took the name Ramona for good in 1894.
Is there a train near Ramona?

Ramona has no station. The nearest rail line is the SPRINTER, which runs 22 miles from Oceanside to the Escondido Transit Center. For a ride on a real steam train, the Poway-Midland Railroad runs in Old Poway Park, including night rides during Poway's Christmas in the Park.
